name: Oxyplug Preload
author: Oxyplug Team

sections.description: Preload post/page featured images and product images to enhance the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and achieve a better Core Web Vitals (CWV) score in Google’s Lighthouse. Additionally, the tool supports preloading fonts, CSS, and JavaScript files when specified manually, allowing for even greater optimization of page load performance.
sections.installation:
Install and activate it. It will preload the featured images automatically.
You can also manually preload fonts, CSS, and JavaScript files in the settings for even better results.
